description: Screenshot one store page in a real browser on desktop and/or mobile and return the images. Pass `draft` to see a Fudge draft. `fullPage` captures top to bottom. Takes 15–60 seconds; up to 50 captures per store per day.

draft.description: A draft’s fudge://project/… ref: capture the page as that draft shows it. Staged product and page content changes appear only on Fudge’s review page, not here.

page.description: A store URL or path, e.g. / or /products/blue-runner. Defaults to the home page, or with `draft` to the page the draft is about.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: capture_page
title: Capture page screenshots
